payload.name: Extract explicit personal-meaning statements from keepsakes
payload.description: Apply during extraction when a user explicitly says an object, photo, or keepsake reminds them of a person, feeling, or memory.
content: During extraction, when the user explicitly states what a personal object, photo, or keepsake reminds them of (e.g., 'this picture reminds me of ...'), create a candidate memory capturing that meaning as a durable state or relationship, even if the object was mentioned earlier or appears incidental.

Do not require an additional cue or question; an explicit 'reminds me of' statement is sufficient evidence to extract. If the statement connects the object to a person, prefer a relationship memory; if it expresses a feeling or value, use state.

solves: Construction extraction missed explicit statements where users disclose the personal significance of objects or keepsakes, so later recall questions were unsupported. This rule generalizes to any future session where a user explicitly describes what something reminds them of; apply it to capture such meaning statements during extraction.
